content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you looking to share or organize some photos?
Yes, I just finished a photo shoot and want to send the proof thumbnails to my client. Can you suggest the best way?

Absolutely! I recommend creating a folder called "Photo Proofs_June2024". Upload the thumbnails there, and set the link to view-only, this keeps your originals safe. You can then share the folder link with your client for easy browsing.
Great. Should I include all the images, or just my top picks?

Including all the thumbnails gives your client more options, but you might want to highlight your favorites in a subfolder called 'Photographer's Picks'. This helps them browse and select easily. Don't forget to name files like 'IMG_001_proof.jpg' for clarity.
I've uploaded everything to the folder. Should I ask the client to mark their selections in any specific way?

Great work! Ask your client to note their selections in a separate document or reply email, this avoids altering the folder. You could include a simple index template in the folder, so they can list chosen filenames. Remind them to click the folder link to browse the proofs before deciding.
There's a lot of files, should I organize by outfit or location?

That's a thoughtful idea! Create subfolders like 'Outdoor_Look1' or 'Studio_BlackDress' for each outfit or location. It helps your client navigate and makes their selection process smoother. You might mention this folder structure when you share the link.
Done! I'll send the link to my client now. Any tips for final delivery once they've picked?

Once you have their choices, export the high-res finals into a new folder named 'Finals_ClientName_June2024_v1'. Set it to view and download access, so they can easily download originals. Let them know to visit the new folder link when ready.
Should I include both JPEG and RAW files?

That depends on your agreement, but providing both gives your client flexibility. You can add a 'JPEG' and a 'RAW' subfolder inside the finals folder. Just be sure to label the versions clearly, like 'Portrait1_Final_v1.jpg'.
Thanks! I'll organize it that way and let them know where to find everything.

Perfect! Add a friendly note encouraging them to click and browse the folders, and to download their selected finals. Let me know if you need a checklist or another template. Your client will appreciate your thoughtful organization!
